Assess source role, temporal limits, legal authority prerequisites, license terms and physical shoreline limitations using cited primary sources and retained source metadata.

conclusions.text: The full source-feature set, full current contact set and all 22 previously accepted whole-component comparison rows are retained and match their declared exact identities and hashes.

The present source-role label “Municipalities” is overgeneralized for the 22 current contacts: the 2026 PSA listings classify 21 as municipalities and Cavite City as a city. This is a current identity/role finding only.

Every contact geometry differs from its corresponding 2020 consumed source geometry under the preserved canonical JSON serialization. This observation does not determine cause, legal authority, or replacement geometry.
The original source is GeoJSON without a crs member; RFC 7946 specifies WGS 84/CRS84 decimal degrees, longitude then latitude, but does not verify the 2020 production chain.
For all 22 components, source-relative physical comparison rows retain their original support classes, while physical source observation fitness/date and authority remain unapproved or unknown.
Unit-specific legal boundaries and effective dates remain unresolved without the applicable laws/ordinances, required plebiscite evidence, and a matched official survey/cadastral plan.
Suitable higher-accuracy physical evidence, mapped coverage, date, registration, tidal datum and reuse permission remain unresolved for these specific components. No raster or scene was queried.

The geoBoundaries source metadata and gbOpen derivative reuse terms need separate attribution and applicability review before any broader reuse; the GSHHG archive license wording conflict remains unresolved.
